name: transition_interpolation_value_color

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_TransitionInterpolationValueColor consumes a value ID, RGB components, and duration; resolves D_0038858C[value_id], normalizes each component by 255, derives per-tick deltas from the value's current color, and decrements Script stackTop by five

notes: A zero duration writes the normalized target color directly; otherwise the handler enables the asynchronous color transition. The two JP calls transition value 0 to (136, 136, 136) and then back to (255, 255, 255), both over duration 2.
